recipe_name: Overnight Oats with Berries and Flax
ingredients: rolled oats; flax seed; chia seed; blueberry; strawberry; walnut; cinnamon; vanilla; soy milk
preparation: Combine oats, seeds, soy milk, cinnamon, vanilla. Refrigerate overnight. Top with berries and walnuts in the morning.

recipe_name: Kale Caesar with Capers and Nutritional Yeast
ingredients: kale (massaged); capers; nutritional yeast; garlic; lemon juice; olive oil; hemp seed; mustard; black pepper
preparation: Massage kale with olive oil and lemon. Add capers, nutritional yeast, hemp seeds. Toss with garlic-mustard dressing.
target_nutrients: quercetin; luteolin; ascorbic acid; lutein; allicin

ingredients: sweet potato; carrot; beet; onion; garlic; rosemary; thyme; olive oil; black pepper; balsamic vinegar
preparation: Cube vegetables. Toss with olive oil, herbs, garlic. Roast at 200°C for 35 min. Drizzle with balsamic.

preparation: Brew green tea, chill. Blend with berries, banana, spinach, flax, lemon.

ingredients: chia seed; cocoa; raspberry; almond milk; vanilla; maple syrup; walnut
preparation: Mix chia, cocoa, almond milk, vanilla, maple syrup. Refrigerate 4+ hours. Top with raspberries and walnuts.

ingredients: broccoli (raw, grated); brussels sprouts (shaved); cabbage; carrot; tahini; lemon juice; garlic; apple cider vinegar; pomegranate seeds; walnut
preparation: Grate broccoli and brussels sprouts. Shave cabbage. Toss with tahini-lemon-garlic dressing. Top with pomegranate and walnuts.
